name: Payments & Billing
owns: Invoices, charges, refunds, subscription plans, payment methods, tax, failed or duplicate payments.

name: Identity & Access
owns: Login, passwords, SSO/SAML, MFA, account lockouts, user roles and permissions, API keys.

name: Platform / SRE
owns: Outages, downtime, errors (5xx), latency, timeouts, degraded performance across the product, status page incidents.

name: Mobile Apps
owns: iOS and Android app crashes, push notifications, app store issues, mobile-only bugs.

name: Data & Integrations
owns: Webhooks, public API behavior, CSV/data exports and imports, third-party integrations (Slack, Salesforce, Zapier).

name: Security
owns: Suspected breaches, phishing, compromised accounts, vulnerability reports, data privacy and GDPR/data deletion requests.

name: Customer Success
owns: How-to questions, onboarding, feature requests, general feedback, anything not clearly owned by another team.
